item.title: China Trusted Data Space Pilot Covers 13 Cities and 136 Vertical Models
item.description:
China's first trusted data space pilot, launched in 2025, has reached a milestone covering 13 cities, 22 industries and 28 enterprises. It has generated 457 high-quality datasets and 136 vertical AI models, enabling scenarios such as multimodal logistics, mutual recognition of carbon footprint accounting and new materials R&D.

原文标题：可信数据空间试点落地 13 城 带动 136 个垂直模型

Why it matters：国家级数据基础设施试点进展披露了数据集与垂直模型的量化成果，是观察中国 AI 数据要素供给的重要信号。

item.title: TikTok Rolls Out AI Content Detector and Likeness Protection Tool
item.description:
TikTok launched a public AI content detection tool that lets anyone, even without an account, upload images or videos to check whether they were generated or edited by TikTok's AI features, including detection of its proprietary invisible watermark VeraDura. It is also rolling out an opt-in Likeness Detection feature globally to help creators find and flag unauthorized AI-generated uses of their likeness. TikTok says it has labeled over 5 billion AI-generated videos and proactively removed more than 99% of violating AI content before user reports.

原文标题：TikTok 上线 AI 内容检测与肖像保护工具

Why it matters：主流平台将 AI 内容溯源与肖像保护产品化，是深度伪造治理的重要落地信号。

item.title: Global Electronics Association Warns PCB Shortage May Last Until 2027
item.description:
The Global Electronics Association issued an industry alert warning that PCB supply shortages are worsening as AI server demand for high-layer-count boards strains capacity. Orders rose 56.1% year-over-year through September while shipments grew only 13.3%, with lead times for high-layer boards reaching 16-20 weeks. The association expects shortages to persist until at least the first half of 2027, with no meaningful relief before mid-2028, a risk comparable to the 2021 chip crunch.

原文标题：全球电子协会警告 PCB 短缺或持续至 2027 年

Why it matters：AI 算力扩张正把瓶颈从芯片转移到 PCB 与上游材料，这一预警直接影响数据中心与硬件供应链排期。

item.description:

The post identifies AI routers as a key exfiltration point and outlines a practical canary-token approach for detecting prompt leaks.

item.title: Fast-Anything Ports Only the Slowest 5% of Code to Rust
item.description:
Fast-Anything proposes an incremental performance path: profile the app to rank hot functions, have a coding agent port only those to Rust, verify equivalence by replaying up to 500 recorded real calls, then swap the port in with one reversible command. It targets Python, Node, Ruby, Java, Go, PHP and C/C++, bridging via a single C entry point that takes and returns JSON, so no per-language bindings are needed.

原文标题：新工具只把最慢的 5% 代码用 Rust 重写

Why it matters：针对“全量重写 Rust”的高成本痛点给出可验证、可回滚的局部移植方案，对性能优化实践有直接参考价值。

item.title: Together AI Discloses Prompt Leak After AI Coding Agent Exposed Credential
item.description:
Together AI disclosed a security incident in which an AI coding agent committed a credential to its public GitHub repository xorl, granting access to a private Hugging Face repo holding prompt samples from MiniMax M3, GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 requests in June and July 2026. An unauthorized party downloaded the samples and searched them for further credentials. The incident highlights supply-chain risk from AI agents in development workflows; Together advises customers handling sensitive prompts to enable zero data retention.

原文标题：Together AI 因 AI 编码代理泄露凭证致提示词外泄

Why it matters：这是 AI 编码代理直接引发真实数据泄露的罕见公开案例，对使用代理式开发与托管推理服务的团队具有直接警示价值。

item.title: Lean Community Verifies 17-Million-Line Riemann Hypothesis Proof
item.description:
The Lean and Mathlib communities jointly announced that Levent Alpöge's roughly 17-million-line Lean formalization of a Riemann Hypothesis proof has passed four verification criteria: correct statement, compilable code, proof-to-statement correspondence, and proof validity. Verification used the official Lean kernel, con-leche, con-ron, and several independent third-party checkers, with relative set-theoretic soundness proofs ruling out checkers accepting invalid proofs. If it holds, this marks a milestone for AI-assisted mathematics and formal verification.

原文标题：Lean 社区核验 1700 万行黎曼猜想形式化证明

Why it matters：黎曼猜想若被形式化证明攻克，将是数学与 AI 辅助推理的历史性节点，且核验流程本身具备高度技术参考价值。

item.description:

The incident highlights how model routing layers can enforce data compliance across upstream providers.

item.title: Amazon Nears $7.5B Decart Deal to Bolster In-House Chips
item.description:
Amazon is nearing a deal to acquire AI startup Decart for roughly $7.5B, nearly double its latest $4B valuation. The strategic driver is Decart's inference optimization, which reportedly delivers more tokens per kilowatt on Amazon's Trainium3, running its real-time video model 4x faster than GPUs at half the cost.

item.title: Phison Unveils Smart SSD with Built-in NPU and 64GB Memory
item.description:
At SC26, Phison showed two enterprise SSDs built for AI workloads. One integrates an NPU and 64GB of memory with 130GB/s bandwidth, running PyTorch, vLLM, OpenVINO and llama.cpp directly on the drive, pushing compute to storage and returning only results to the host, which Phison says can cut data movement by 10-100x on certain workloads. The other uses a mixed-media design pairing pSLC cache with QLC flash, limiting cache loss to 4% per failed drive versus 25% in traditional dedicated-cache setups.

原文标题：群联展示内置 NPU 与 64GB 内存的智能固态硬盘

Why it matters：存储侧计算是 AI 基础设施的重要演进方向，该产品把推理能力直接嵌入 SSD，对算力与数据搬运成本有实质影响。

item.title: OpenAI Cuts Chain-of-Thought Extraction Rate to 0.2 Percent

Combined with weekly bans of thousands to tens of thousands of unauthorized distillation accounts, the move signals frontier labs are now actively defending reasoning traces as core assets.

item.title: Signal Blocks Screenshots by Default to Stop AI Agents Reading Chats

Signal now blocks screenshots by default on iOS and Android to prevent system-level AI agents such as Siri AI and Gemini from reading private messages. President Meredith Whittaker framed the move as a defense of end-to-end encryption against expanding on-device AI, while macOS lacks the tooling for equivalent protection.

item.title: Anthropic Mathematician and Claude Claim Riemann Hypothesis Proof in Lean
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced that he and Claude have produced a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, delivered as 17 million lines of Lean code, which the Lean FRO and Mathlib community have jointly certified as passing all verification criteria. It marks the first time AI has contributed to cracking a 160-year-old top-tier open problem at this scale of formal verification. On the same day, a purely human proof draft from Stanford was flagged with issues by AI within hours, offering a sharp contrast.

原文标题：Anthropic 数学家与 Claude 联手证明黎曼猜想

Why it matters：AI 首次参与攻克悬置 160 余年的顶级数学难题并通过大规模形式化验证，是 AI 时间线上的里程碑事件。

item.title: Google to Shut Down Nest App in 2027, Folding Features into Google Home
item.description:
Google will shut down the standalone Nest app and web portal on January 15, 2027, automatically migrating thermostats, cameras, doorbells and schedules into Google Home, with legacy Nest Aware subscriptions converted to Google Home Premium at no extra cost. On August 2, 2027, Google Assistant will also be retired, with Google Home and Gemini taking over first-party speakers and third-party devices such as Sonos.

item.title: UT Austin System Beats Human Champion at Times Crossword Championship
item.description:
A University of Texas at Austin team's automated system, Darmok, solved all seven British cryptic crossword puzzles error-free at the 2026 Times Crossword Championship, beating the human champion by 3 minutes 13 seconds in the Final, the first automated system to reach superhuman performance in this event. Notably, the primary model provider slowed sharply during the Final, and backup routing supplied 17 of the 30 answers, underscoring the value of multi-model redundancy for latency-critical tasks.

原文标题：UT Austin 系统在《泰晤士报》填字锦标赛中击败人类冠军

item.title: PcapAnalyzer 开源 27 项网络故障检测器
item.description:
PcapAnalyzer 是一款 Apache 2.0 开源的本地化 pcap/pcapng 抓包分析工具，内置 27 个检测器，覆盖 TCP 重传与窗口异常、PMTUD 黑洞、DNS/DHCP/ARP 故障、TLS 告警及 IPsec/WireGuard 等隧道问题，并为每项发现给出严重级别与下一步排查建议。抓包数据完全在本地处理，适合对数据外泄敏感的网络运维场景，目前处于 beta 阶段。

Why it matters：面向网络排障的开源本地抓包分析工具，检测器覆盖面广且给出可执行排查建议，对运维与 SRE 读者有直接实用价值。

item.title: 马里兰大学研究：前沿模型可凭文风识别匿名作者
item.description:
马里兰大学新论文发现，前沿模型在零样本提示下即可检测 AI 生成文本，准确率与 Pangram 等训练过的检测器相当，并能给出推理依据。更关键的是，模型仅凭单篇文本就能推断作者所属 AI 实验室甚至具体个人，在 398 篇匿名同行评审中 Claude Fable 5.2 命中 56% 的评审人，在 Reddit 重度用户评论中命中 69% 的账号。这意味着匿名评审与化名社区的匿名性假设正被削弱。

Why it matters：该研究把文风指纹识别推到前沿模型的原生能力层面，直接冲击匿名评审与化名社区的隐私假设。

item.title: Signal 限制移动端截图以应对 AI 代理监控威胁
item.description:

Why it matters：端到端加密通讯应用首次因操作系统级 AI 代理的屏幕读取能力而收紧截图权限，折射出 AI 代理与隐私边界的结构性冲突。

item.title: 施密特称 AI 竞赛无法相互暂停
item.description:
